#include <iostream>
#include <algorithm>
using namespace std;

long long int powers[18];
int minimum_moves=0;

void search(int current_sum, long long int remaining, int position)
{
    if(current_sum > minimum_moves)
        return;
    if(remaining == 0)
    {
        minimum_moves = min(minimum_moves, current_sum);
        return;
    }
    int needed = remaining / powers[position];
    search(current_sum + (position * needed++), remaining - (needed * powers[position]), position - 1);
    search(current_sum + needed * position, needed * powers[position] - remaining, position - 1);
}

int main()
{
    long long int number;
    cin >> number;
    powers[1] = 1;
    for(int i=2; i<18; i++)
        powers[i] = (10 * powers[i-1]) + 1;
    long long int temp = number;
    minimum_moves = 0;
    while(temp > 0)
    {
        for(int i=1; i<18; i++)
        {
            if(powers[i] > temp)
            {
                minimum_moves += (i - 1);
                temp -= powers[i - 1];
                break;
            }
        }
    }
    search(0, number, 16);
    cout << minimum_moves << endl;
}
